svc.heading: Services
svc.f_host: Host routing (optional, instead of/in addition to the path)
svc.f_host_hint: Hostname this service is reached under (e.g. app.example.com) – HAProxy then routes by Host header, with no path prefix (good for SPAs/WebSockets, also behind a wildcard tunnel). Empty = route by path only.
svc.f_link: External link (instead of a backend) – opens in a new tab
svc.f_link_hint: Absolute URL (https://…). If set, the tile only links out, creates no route; path/backend/servers/timeouts are ignored. Reachability optional via the health check below.
svc.ssl_warn: ⚠ Only disable this if the backend uses a self-signed certificate – without verification the connection to the backend is vulnerable to MITM (only relevant for https).
svc.backend_ca_hint: "Internal CA" = step-ca (CA profile). "Custom CAs" = a root CA or self-signed target cert uploaded under "Trusted backend CAs". SNI = backend hostname.
svc.tls_server_name_hint: Only for https with certificate verification. Empty = the name is derived from the backend address. Set it when the backend is reached by IP but its certificate is issued to a name (e.g. app1.local) – it is then verified against that name (SNI/verifyhost). Hostname only, no IP.
svc.f_strip: Strip the path prefix before forwarding
svc.f_deny_hint: Relative to the service path (e.g. /admin); requests return 403.
svc.hc_hint: Sends GET with Host = domain and X-Forwarded-Proto: https.
svc.f_servers: Additional servers (one per line, host:port) – load balancing
svc.f_servers_hint: Leave empty for a single backend. Load balancing kicks in from two servers.
svc.f_extra_paths: Additional paths (one per line, no separate tile)
svc.f_extra_paths_hint: Routed to the same backend as the main path.
svc.f_hidden: No tile on the dashboard (route stays active)
svc.hc_header_file: …value from a secret file under data/config/secrets/
svc.hc_header_hint: The header value is read from the secret file and never stored in services.yaml.
theme.heading: Appearance & domain
theme.show_status: Show backend status on the dashboard
theme.logo_upload: Upload logo (png, jpg, svg, gif, webp, ico)
dc.heading: Domains & certificates
dc.aliases_hint: Example: wiki.example.local /wiki keep — 301-redirects the old domain to the platform (path + query preserved). "keep" avoids a double prefix. "root=/target" sets a dedicated target for "/" (independent of path preservation). For HTTPS on alias domains, add a matching certificate.
dc.platform_intro: Default certificate of the HTTPS frontend. View and replace it here — without a container restart. Uploaded SNI certificates for the same name take precedence. The certs/ path on the host remains as an alternative.
dc.platform_src_host: file in certs/ on the host
dc.platform_unreadable: Certificate not readable or not parseable.
dc.platform_replace_hint: The key must match the certificate. Activated without a restart (reload); the previous version is kept as a backup.
dc.platform_revert_confirm: Remove the GUI-managed platform certificate and fall back to the certificate in certs/ or the self-signed one?
dc.certs_intro: Upload additional certificates here (e.g. for alias domains) — HAProxy selects by SNI and prefers them over the platform certificate. Private keys are never shown.
dc.cert_key: Private key (.key) – omit for PKCS#12 or if included in the PEM
dc.cert_passphrase_hint: Only needed for a password-protected key or PKCS#12 (.pfx/.p12). Decrypts the key on upload; it is stored unencrypted and the passphrase is not kept (HAProxy itself cannot load encrypted keys).
ca.heading: Trusted backend CAs
ca.intro: Certificates HAProxy verifies https backends against when a service uses "backend CA = custom". Public certificates only (no private key): a company/AD root CA or a target's self-signed certificate.
ca.hint: Example: export your company/AD CA's root certificate as Base64/PEM and upload it here, then set the service's "backend CA" to "custom".
tcp.heading: TCP streams
tcp.intro: Plain TCP forwarding (mode tcp) on dedicated ports – e.g. database, SSH, SMTP. Optional TLS termination with the platform certificate.
tcp.compose_hint: Put these ports into a docker-compose.override.yml (template: docker-compose.override.yml.example) and run "docker compose up -d". The override is loaded automatically and survives updates - unlike entries in docker-compose.yml:
tcp.f_servers_hint: One server is enough. Load balancing kicks in from two servers.
tcp.f_tls: TLS termination with the platform certificate
notify.heading: Notifications
notify.webhook_url: Webhook URL (POST JSON on every event)
notify.direct_hint: Direct delivery is convenient but often blocked by providers (port 25 closed) or spam filters (missing PTR/SPF/DKIM) – use an SMTP host for reliable delivery.

flash.ssl_none_warn: Warning: “{name}” uses https WITHOUT certificate verification (MITM possible).
flash.logo_bad_format: Logo format not supported (allowed: png, jpg, svg, gif, webp, ico).
flash.svg_rejected: SVG rejected: contains scripts/event handlers (possible XSS).
flash.notify_no_channel: No channel configured (email recipients/SMTP or webhook missing).

flash.update_manual: Automatic update is not active (UPDATE_MODE=manual). Please run the command shown.
flash.confirm_mismatch: Confirmation failed: please type exactly “{target}” to confirm.
flash.update_requested: Update to {target} requested – the host-side updater verifies the signature, pulls the images and restarts with healthcheck/rollback …
flash.rollback_none: No previous version known – rollback not possible.
flash.rollback_invalid: Previous version is invalid – rollback aborted.
flash.rollback_requested: Rollback to {target} requested – the host-side updater verifies the signature, pulls the images and restarts with healthcheck …
flash.field_invalid_name: Name missing or contains invalid control characters.
flash.field_invalid_path: Invalid path: allowed are /, letters, digits, . _ - (no spaces/special characters).
flash.field_invalid_backend: Invalid backend: only host/container[:port] or ip[:port] allowed.
flash.field_invalid_link: Invalid external link: only http(s)://host[:port][/path], no spaces/quotes.
flash.field_invalid_tls_server_name: Invalid TLS server name (a hostname only, no IP, no spaces).
flash.field_invalid_host: Invalid host: hostname only (letters/digits/.-), no scheme/path/port.
flash.ca_need_file: Please choose a CA / certificate file.
flash.ca_has_key: Rejected: the file contains a private key - only public certificates belong here.
flash.ca_invalid: Invalid or unreadable certificate (PEM or DER, without a key).
flash.field_invalid_scheme: Scheme must be http or https.
flash.field_invalid_color: Invalid color: hex (e.g. #22c55e) or a simple color name.
flash.field_invalid_timeout: Invalid timeout: only time values like 600s, 10m, 1h (max. 24h).
flash.field_invalid_deny: Invalid blocked path: allowed are /, letters, digits, . _ -.
flash.field_invalid_healthcheck: Invalid health check: check the path, status (e.g. 200|301), interval and header name/file.
flash.field_invalid_balance: Invalid load balancing (only roundrobin or leastconn).
flash.field_invalid_match: Invalid path match (only exact or prefix).
flash.tcp_port_taken: Port {port} is already used by another TCP stream.
flash.alias_invalid: Invalid alias: hostname strict (letters/digits/.-), path like /wiki.
flash.cert_need_both: Certificate and key required (both files or one combined PEM).
flash.cert_invalid: Certificate could not be read (invalid PEM).
flash.cert_bad_name: Invalid file name for the certificate.
flash.cert_key_mismatch: The private key does not match the certificate.
flash.cert_key_passphrase: The key could not be read — passphrase missing or wrong.
flash.cert_key_cipher_unsupported: The private key is encrypted with an unsupported algorithm. Please export it as PKCS#12/PFX (.pfx) or re-encrypt the key with 3DES or AES.
flash.cert_write_failed: The certificate could not be saved (write error).
flash.platform_cert_saved: Platform certificate replaced — active without a restart.
flash.platform_cert_restored: Previous version of the platform certificate restored.
flash.platform_cert_reverted: GUI management removed — certs/ or the self-signed certificate applies again.
